notes: BUB1B (NM_001211.6) c.2210T>G p.(Leu737Ter) + c.3006T>G p.(Asn1002Lys), both heterozygous. Stop-gain in exon 17/23 (NMD predicted), gnomAD max population AF 1.0e-4, ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic for MVA syndrome 1 (2 stars); missense in exon 23/23, gnomAD max population AF <1e-6, AlphaMissense 0.92. Biallelic BUB1B loss causes autosomal recessive MVA; the variants are 10.9 kb apart and phase could not be resolved from short reads. EPCR rationale: highest value; known autosomal recessive MVA gene, one ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic truncating allele plus an ultra-rare predicted-damaging missense, and ranked first by all six methods; below 1 because the trans configuration is unconfirmed.

BUB1B c.2210T>G p.(Leu737Ter) alone: heterozygous stop-gain, ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic (2 stars), gnomAD max population AF 1.0e-4. Listed singly in case the second BUB1B allele is not a called small variant. EPCR rationale: covers the case where the stop-gain is causal with a second allele not detected as a small variant; lower than the pair because it requires an undetected second hit.

BUB1B c.3006T>G p.(Asn1002Lys) alone: heterozygous missense in the last exon, AlphaMissense 0.92 (likely pathogenic), REVEL 0.47, gnomAD max population AF <1e-6; not in ClinVar. EPCR rationale: covers the case where the missense alone is causal; lower than the stop-gain because it has no ClinVar record and is classified as a VUS under ACMG criteria by Exomiser.

Novel regulatory candidate about 47 kb upstream of BUB1B: heterozygous intergenic variant, gnomAD max population AF 6.7e-3; AlphaGenome predicts increased chromatin accessibility (ATAC) at the site, weak support. Listed as a possible regulatory BUB1B allele for follow-up. EPCR rationale: non-coding with prediction-only support; highest of the regulatory candidates because it lies near BUB1B.

Novel regulatory candidate about 29 kb upstream of SMC5: heterozygous 2-bp deletion, gnomAD max population AF 1.5e-3; AlphaGenome predicts increased TF ChIP-seq signal in neural cells, weak support. Listed for follow-up. EPCR rationale: non-coding with prediction-only support; below the BUB1B regulatory candidate because BUB1B carries the primary candidate alleles.

ACLY (ENST00000352035.7) c.730C>T p.(Arg244Trp): heterozygous missense, AlphaMissense 0.93, REVEL 0.81, gnomAD max population AF 6.4e-6; not in ClinVar; not a known MVA gene. EPCR rationale: very rare with strong damaging predictions, but a single heterozygous allele in a gene not linked to MVA; highest of the non-MVA-gene candidates (ranked 9th by Exomiser).

DIDO1 (ENST00000395343.6, NM_001193369.2, MANE Select) c.-200+2_-200+8del: heterozygous 7-bp deletion at the splice donor of 5' UTR intron 1, within a CCGCAGG repeat; protein sequence unchanged; absent from gnomAD; not in ClinVar; PASS in both call sets with alternate reads on both strands. The transcript encodes the longest DIDO1 isoform; loss of Dido3, the largest Dido splice variant, causes early BubR1 degradation and aneuploidy in mouse cells (PMID 17299043). EPCR rationale: single heterozygous non-coding allele in a gene not established for MVA, but the only such candidate with a published link to BubR1 and aneuploidy; below ACLY and above ARL9.

ARL9 (ENST00000640821.3) c.717_720del p.(Thr240Argfs*16): heterozygous frameshift, gnomAD max population AF 8.8e-5; not in ClinVar; not a known MVA gene. EPCR rationale: single heterozygous frameshift in a gene not linked to MVA, with no ClinVar record; least supporting evidence, so lowest of the primary rows.

Incidental finding in a gene not established for MVA: LZTR1 (ENST00000646124.2) c.2244C>G p.(Tyr748Ter), heterozygous stop-gain, ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic (2 stars; Noonan syndrome 2 and 10, LZTR1-related schwannomatosis), gnomAD max population AF 3.0e-5. Flagged for clinical review. EPCR rationale: reported as an incidental finding, not proposed as causal for MVA; low value so it ranks below all primary rows.

Incidental finding in a gene not established for MVA: GNRHR (ENST00000226413.5) c.416G>A p.(Arg139His), heterozygous, ClinVar pathogenic (2 stars; hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 7), gnomAD max population AF 9.5e-4. Carrier finding in an autosomal recessive gene. EPCR rationale: incidental carrier finding in a recessive gene, not proposed as causal for MVA; lowest value.
